facts.fact: SADC states that on 27 July 2026 the Angolan kwanza was introduced as a settlement currency in the SADC-RTGS system, the second after the rand, which 15 countries use.
SADC says 2025 trade and interbank transactions between Angola and the other 14 SADC states were about US$3.77 billion across nine currencies, South Africa taking about US$2.99 billion.

systems.owner: South African Reserve Bank (operator, for SADC CCBG)
